title: Metastable multimeric G-quadruplex 2′FY-RNA aptamers that selectively bind pyoverdines
task: Identify G-quadruplex RNA aptamers selective for pyoverdine binding
key_results: Two 2′FY-RNA aptamers formed dimeric G-quadruplexes with thermal metastability; structures reformed upon PVD-Pf5 binding and showed pressure stability up to 2 kbar

hypotheses.result: Differential specificity demonstrated across pyoverdine variants

title: Withanolide A inhibits hIAPP aggregation: An In silico, biophysical, and drosophila-based In vivo validation
task: Identify and validate natural product inhibitors of hIAPP aggregation
key_results: Withanolide A increased hIAPP lag phase, reduced β-sheet content by ~40% (FTIR), and inhibited fibril formation; in Drosophila, reduced glucose levels and mitigated oligomer-induced toxicity
comments: The complementary use of computational screening, biophysical validation, and organismal models strengthens the therapeutic claim, though human clinical efficacy remains untested.

outputs: Withaferin A and Withanolide A as lead candidates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Withanolide A inhibits hIAPP aggregation by stabilizing monomers and delaying fibril formation

hypotheses.result: Drosophila assays showed reduced apoptosis, necrosis, and ROS; glucose levels decreased in diabetic flies

title: SRD5A3-mediated aberrant N-glycosylation of SCARA5 promotes ferroptosis in lung adenocarcinoma
task: Elucidate SRD5A3-mediated N-glycosylation regulation of ferroptosis in lung adenocarcinoma
key_results: SRD5A3 upregulation correlates with poor LUAD outcomes; SRD5A3 depletion suppressed A549/H1299 proliferation, invasion, migration by triggering ferroptosis; loss of SRD5A3 caused SCARA5 hyper-N-glycosylation, impairing FTL binding and promoting Fe²⁺ release and lipid peroxidation; tunicamycin reversed ferroptosis sensitivity confirming N-glycosylation dependency
comments: The study establishes a detailed glycosylation-ferroptosis regulatory axis with site-directed mutagenesis validation, though therapeutic targeting of this pathway in vivo remains unexplored.

hypotheses.result: 40× error reduction vs. single-reservoir baseline for superimposed oscillator prediction

title: Observation of ubiquitous charge correlations and hidden quantum critical point in hole-doped kagome superconductors
task: Reveal charge-density-wave order and hidden quantum critical point in hole-doped kagome superconductors
key_results: Incipient ISD-π CDW puddles observed above Tc and pinned by disorder; hidden QCP at x ≈ 0.12 where ideal CDW order vanishes between superconducting domes
comments: NQR provides local sensitivity to fragmented phases, though direct real-space imaging of CDW puddles and their defect-pinning would strengthen conclusions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: In absence of disorder, CDW order vanishes at critical doping between superconducting domes
hypotheses.result: Hidden QCP identified at x ≈ 0.12; quenched disorder pins ISD-π patches beyond this point

title: Deep learning-accelerated NEGF formalism for autonomous design of quantum transport in microscopic heterostructures
task: Accelerate NEGF quantum transport simulations using deep learning tight-binding models
key_results: DeePTB-NEGF achieves 700× speedup for graphene/h-BN/graphene heterostructures; simulates hundreds of atoms in minutes with DFT-NEGF accuracy
comments: Practical framework combining deep learning with established quantum transport formalism; validation limited to five prototype 2D materials.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning tight-binding models preserve quantum transport accuracy while reducing cost
hypotheses.result: Excellent agreement with DFT-NEGF for band structures and transmission, with 700× speedup

title: Hydrothermal synthesis of morus alba waste biomass-derived carbon dots with enhanced quantum yield for optoelectronic chitosan nanocomposites
task: Synthesize chitosan-carbon quantum dot nanocomposites with tunable optical/electronic properties
key_results: CQD quantum yield 9.46%; bandgap reduced from 4.97 eV to 2.35 eV; optical resistivity decreased from 0.0519 to 0.0033 Ω·m via CQD incorporation
comments: Comprehensive characterization of optical tunability is thorough; practical device performance in UV coatings or optoelectronics remains experimentally undemonstrated.

model_io.model: Morus alba-derived CQDs dispersed in chitosan matrix

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong CQD-chitosan interfacial interaction disrupts polymer semicrystallinity and reduces electronic bandgap
hypotheses.result: 2.6 eV bandgap reduction and 16× enhancement in optical conductivity with 20 wt% CQD loading

title: Holographic leaky-wave antennas with independently controlled multiple counter-rotating vortex beams
task: Design holographic metasurfaces for independent control of multiple counter-rotating vortex beams
key_results: Dual-beam prototype with independent OAM (l=±3) and polarization control; six-lobed vortex beam with pencil beam simultaneously radiated
comments: Systematic generalized aperture method for anisotropic surfaces is well-executed, though fabrication tolerances for multi-lobe control merit discussion.

model_io.model: Anisotropic metasurface hologram with modulated impedance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anisotropic impedance surfaces enable simultaneous independent control of polarization and OAM for multiple beams
hypotheses.result: Dual-beam with RCP vortex (l=±3, six-lobed) and LCP pencil successfully synthesized

title: A tri-axis optomechanical accelerometer with plasmonic MIM waveguide and structural direction-dependent optical signatures
task: Design tri-axis optomechanical accelerometer with plasmonic transduction and sub-µg sensitivity
key_results: NEA ≈ 0.78 µg/√Hz with 40×10⁻³ nm⁻¹ tri-axis normalized sensitivity; Fano-type resonance (insertion loss −6.29 dB) enables wavelength-intensity discrimination
comments: Sophisticated integration of MEMS, plasmonics, and Fano resonance; noise floor claims would benefit from experimental validation on fabricated device.

model_io.model: Mono-proof-mass MEMS with MIM plasmonic waveguide

hypotheses.hypothesis: Asymmetric structure and Fano resonance enable direction-sensitive optical signatures for tri-axis decoupling
hypotheses.result: Bidirectional sensitivity matrix maps nanoscale displacements to simultaneous wavelength and intensity changes

title: Many-body superconductivity in topological flat bands
task: Classify many-body excitations and pairing in flat-band superconductors
key_results: Cooper pair bound states obey effective single-boson hopping with zero-energy excitations determined by quantum metric; strongest pairing occurs at half-filling
comments: Elegant analytical construction of exact ground states, though experimental validation of predicted topological pairing structures remains absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flat bands suppress fermion kinetic energy, enabling strong pairing at specific densities
hypotheses.result: Maximum pairing strength at half-filling rather than maximum density of states
